pairing: Identical frozen input bytes, independent calls and no shared conversation history; counterbalance zh/en order per pair.
replication: One first-valid result per language for 36 trajectories; one additional independent call per language for 8 selected trajectories.
retry_rule: Only transport/schema failures; never choose best-of valid labels; retain every attempt.
model_snapshot_policy: Record resolved model/version if available; an alias may change over time. Interleave arms in the same execution window.
source_payload_rule: Pass only the pinned prepared input JSON; never include selection metadata, old judgments, official outcomes, or reference labels.
